function progressFacts(history) {

function projectProgressRow(value) {
  if (typeof value !== `object` || value === null || !(`id` in value) || typeof value.id !== `number` || !(`rank` in value) || typeof value.rank !== `number` || !(`markers` in value) || !Array.isArray(value.markers) || !value.markers.every((marker) => typeof marker === `number`))
    throw new Error(`public row has an invalid id/rank/markers payload`);
  return { id: value.id, rank: value.rank, markers: [...value.markers] };
}
function projectProgressRows(value) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error(`public snapshot is not an array`);
  return value.map(projectProgressRow);
